create_kmeans_model: create a KmeansModel instance from a kmeans_uri, device, and dtype to load pretrained clustering centroids
run_kmeans_forward: run the KmeansModel forward pass on input tensors to assign each vector to its nearest centroid
build_kmeans_inference: build a kmeans inference pipeline that loads pretrained centroids and maps input embeddings to cluster indices
test_kmeans_assignment: test the KmeansModel forward method by verifying input tensors are correctly assigned to nearest centroid indices
review_kmeans_distance: review the KmeansModel distance computation that uses squared Euclidean distance to find nearest centroids
